name: bKash Merchant Gateway
author: Alom's English Center
description: Admin-managed bKash Tokenized Checkout plugin with hosted payment initiation, authenticated callback reconciliation, server-side payment status verification, execution, replay protection and settlement through the Universal Payment Core. Merchant credentials are encrypted at rest; live processing requires merchant-issued production credentials and successful UAT.

settings_schema.label: bKash Environment
settings_schema.help: Use Sandbox until provider UAT is complete. Live mode uses production bKash endpoints.

settings_schema.label: bKash App Key
settings_schema.help: Merchant App Key issued by bKash during Tokenized Checkout onboarding. Encrypted at rest.

settings_schema.label: bKash App Secret
settings_schema.help: Merchant App Secret issued by bKash. Encrypted at rest and never returned to the browser.

settings_schema.label: bKash API Username
settings_schema.help: bKash API username for this merchant environment. Encrypted at rest.

settings_schema.label: bKash API Password
settings_schema.help: bKash API password for this merchant environment. Encrypted at rest.
